state.project: CC - North Georgia Data Network Upgrades
state.description: Construct approximately 7 miles of 115kV line with minimum 170C 1351 ACSS conductor from Gillsville Tap Junction to Midway. Utilize the existing GPC owned North Jackson - Lawrence Smith 46kV ROW that is to be retired. Disconnect the East Maysville 115kV tap at Midway 115kV and terminate the new Pond Fork - Midway 115kV line.

q.instructions: Is this OpenStreetMap substation the endpoint the filing names?

criteria.true: Same facility: the name matches and the operator, voltage and state are consistent with the project.
criteria.false: A different facility, e.g. a similarly named substation of another utility or in another state or region than the project describes.
